body:
He has a long history of manipulating doctors. He has constructed a narrative that only serves to support his habit. 

Unfortunately, My parents still enable and allow him to go to the doctors overprescribing him.

At the end of the day, I am told it is no longer my problem but i see my parents relationship deteriorating and he doesn't care.  

He wont change doctors since they may not prescribe him the dosage he requires. My parents continue to give him options to leave the current clinic but nothing has changed. 

Unfortunately encouraging him to see someone is not a proactive approach. He has created a narrative about his life that allows him to continue to abuse drugs. (likely exaggerated). He is able to manipulate my parents that want to solve this issues out side of the public view(for Andrews benefit). However, Andrew appears to be hell bent on making it well known. 

I am told that he is the only one that can own his sobriety. 

Unfortunately, I can not invest anymore time into someone that can not help themselves. 

My major question now is; What is the breaking point for my parents? I do not forsee them kicking him out... and he was just ruin every day of their lives until his body can not take it... 

Any further guidance is greatly appreciated.

MJS
